summary: Iter56 SINGLE-FOCUS test: HTML5 native drag-and-drop on Kanban PipelineBoard at /ops/va-program/pipeline. All three drag gestures verified end-to-end via JS-dispatched DragEvent + shared DataTransfer (dragstart tick separated from drop tick so React setDragId flushes before handleDrop closure runs). Backend was NOT tested (iter55 already covered 18/18). Cleanup performed.

issues: React hydration warning: <span data-ve-dynamic> injected as child of <option> (from ve tooling). Non-blocking but pollutes console. Not caused by app code — safe to ignore in prod build.

critical_code_review_comments: PipelineBoard.jsx handleDrop reads dragId from closure — works fine with real browser drag because state is flushed between dragstart→drop by user gesture timing; only synthetic single-tick JS dispatch reveals the timing coupling. Not a bug in production.
STAGE_TRANSITIONS is duplicated verbatim in both PipelineBoard.jsx (lines 16-24) and AdminVAPipeline.jsx (lines 21-29). Extract to /app/frontend/src/lib/pipelineStages.js to avoid drift.
STAGES array is also duplicated across the same two files (lines 6-14 vs 11-19). Same recommendation — single source of truth.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_iter56_setup_drag_leads.py (created — helper to seed CRMTEST-drag leads + cleanup)
seed_data_creation: Created two CRMTEST-drag-{tag}-{suffix} leads via POST /api/va/leads as va.demo, advanced one through contacted→quoted→booked→completed as admin via PUT /api/pm/leads/{id}/stage. Both soft-deleted via DELETE /api/pm/leads/{id} after tests (both returned 200).
context_for_next_testing_agent: HTML5 drag-and-drop cannot be exercised via Playwright locator.drag_to() in headless Chromium for this app because React's onDragStart mutates state and the same-tick drop closure would still see stale dragId. Working pattern: (1) evaluate DRAGSTART_JS on source with a shared window.__iter56_dt DataTransfer, (2) await page.wait_for_timeout(500) so setDragId flushes, (3) evaluate DROP_JS on target dispatching dragenter+dragover+drop with the same DataTransfer. See exact JS snippets in iteration_56 conversation log. paid stage prompt is a window.prompt — register page.on('dialog', ...) BEFORE the drop dispatch.
